title: Chemistry.
description: Explore physical, organic and inorganic chemistry with advanced mathematical application and practical investigation.

sections.title: Physical Chemistry
sections.text: Atomic structure, thermodynamics, kinetics, equilibria, acids and bases, electrochemistry and rate equations.

sections.title: Inorganic Chemistry
sections.text: Periodicity, Group 2 and 7 chemistry, transition metals and complex ions.

sections.title: Organic Chemistry
sections.text: Reaction mechanisms, alkanes, alkenes, halogenoalkanes, alcohols, carbonyls, aromatic chemistry and polymers.

sections.title: Analytical Techniques
sections.text: Mass spectrometry, IR, NMR spectroscopy and chromatography.

sections.title: Practical Skills
sections.text: Titrations, calorimetry, synthesis and purification, error analysis and evaluation.
